body.heading: Where in the world is Grenada?
paragraphs: Grenada is a country in Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Grenada is St. George's.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Grenada is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Grenada is the East Caribbean dollar.

body.heading: How big is Grenada?
paragraphs: Grenada covers about 344 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Dominica.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Grand Anse is two miles of white sand by the horseshoe harbour of St George's, one of the Caribbean's prettiest capitals.
Grenada's Molinere Bay hides statues standing on the sea floor — snorkel or dive among the famous figures as fish and coral claim them.
